name: print-social-black-ai-platform-feature-grid-post-with-blue-cards
title: Black 'What is AI Platform?' post with four blue-edged feature cards
whatItIs: A black portrait post: a small blue label 'Meet AI Platform', a large 'What is AI Platform?' headline with the product in blue, and a 2x2 grid of dark cards with blue top glows, line icons and titles (Research, Content Planning, Human-Like Content, Direct Publishing), plus a footer bar.
whatItMeans: Clean and product-led; the glowing cards feel like UI, making the post read as a preview of the software itself.
techniques: Present features as a 2x2 card grid with icon tiles.
Light each card with a subtle top gradient edge.
Colour just the product name in the headline.
Close with a footer bar that looks like app chrome.

vocabulary.definition: Equal cards each explaining one capability.
A soft gradient light along a card border.
